historical_analysis_limitations: Twenty-four AI stimuli in eight source families; no human labels or accepted aesthetic oracle.
Native scalar descriptions and within-pair directions only; no intended-transform correctness or candidate inference.
Incomplete/unadmitted banks have no scalar or weighted coverage/bounds; CA/N/A remain native states.
HBQ bounds are rubric-sensitivity bounds, not statistical confidence intervals.
POEMetric item 10 is primary; absence codes 7/8 are diagnostic categories; fixed-form-to-free-verse transfer is unvalidated.
Raw agreement/kappa are descriptive; sparse form-balanced sentinels do not establish population reliability.
Reported token coverage is native completed-turn usage only; latency, unreported tokens, cost/cache and physical contact count remain unavailable.

limitations: AI review supplies synthetic diagnostic evidence, not human judgments or independent endpoint evaluation.
The first image-poem follow-up reuses the independently created consequence reviewer; seven native conversations cover eight packets.
Historical fieldless packets use filter version1; five new packets use version2. Complete role blindness across every historical packet is not asserted.
Local criterion failures do not settle global artistic quality; plausible poetry and speculative alternatives remain unresolved.
Novel scenes are bounded two-scene segments; no unseen whole-novel quality claim follows.
No intended-defect success rate, human alignment gain or rubric promotion is established by these reviews.
